user_saw: In Templates and Plugins, a selected category filter chip looked almost the same as an unselected chip under the pointer.
summary: Gave the active plugin/template catalog chip its own solid inverted fill (text-color background, canvas-color label) instead of sharing the hover style.
reasoning: The parent CSS deliberately grouped `.plugin-catalog-chip:hover, .plugin-catalog-chip.is-active` (from #142782 and older code), so selection styling worked as designed and only looked too similar to hover; PR #202073 restyles it. Nothing broke and no commit regressed it, so this is a visual design refinement titled as a fix.
